newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Thierry Daman said Commissioner Bonino's press conference had been postponed until Tuesday. No time had yet been set.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/748: European Parliament receives an independent evaluation of Phare and Tacis
- IP/97/749: The Commission supports three urban areas in France in their fight against social exclusion and unemployment
